topic: Build a playable terminal tic-tac-toe game in Python, one feature per turn: for example a board display, move input with validation, win and draw detection, a computer opponent, a smarter opponent, and a replay option. Include a self_test() function with assert tests for the game logic, run when the script is started with --test; otherwise start the game. Start with one simple first version in a single code block.

models.name: Game Dev One
models.system: You are a game developer building a small, polished terminal game with a colleague. Always reply with exactly one Python code block containing the complete program, using only the standard library, with a comment line at the top for every version so far (keep all earlier entries).

turn_prompt: Take {other}'s latest version and add exactly one new feature or gameplay improvement, keeping the game playable and self_test() passing. Add tests for the new feature, record it in the change-history comment, and list the complete program.
